name: ponytail-simplification
title: Ponytail-style repository simplification
description: Reduce unnecessary complexity identified by the whole-repository Ponytail review: shrink the generic backend capability model, complete single-owner extraction staging, unify volume-resolution integration, and delete dead configuration/UI/CLI/API surface without weakening safety or retained behavior.
creator: charl
notes: This is a complexity-reduction task, not a generic cleanup sweep. Delete/reuse/shrink only after confirming real callers. Preserve trust-boundary validation, archive safety, strict cleanup, cancellation, corruption/data-loss handling, and meaningful regression tests. Do not merge crates merely to reduce file count.

decisions.priority_order: delete > reuse > stdlib/native > yagni > shrink > dependency
decisions.routing: retain concrete multi-backend fallback and diagnostics, remove generic capability-policy machinery that has no production consumer
decisions.staging: complete ADR-009; exactly one extraction staging owner
decisions.volumes: one canonical list/extract volume resolution and materialization integration path
decisions.config: retain only settings with a production consumer
decisions.placeholders: do not expose CLI/GUI/API shells for unavailable future capabilities
decisions.safety: simplification must not weaken safety, cancellation, cleanup verification, corruption handling, or data-loss protection
decisions.crates: do not merge existing workspace crates without a concrete consumer-based reason
decisions.loc: LOC reduction is an estimate and never a target
